Develop a research question, then answer it through a short data story mainly composed of [effective visualizations](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1Q-C0sFxYGQvkxb6PU6OM_YOv6Nilalpk-IWb362PoRc/preview?slide=id.g13360dab5d5_0_61#slide=id.g13360dab5d5_0_61).  Provide sufficient background for readers to grasp your narrative.  Refer to the Homework Instructions ⭐ page on the course website for details on how to submit this part.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load(2026, week = 45)

fiction_citations <- tuesdata$fiction_citations
fiction_deaths <- tuesdata$fiction_deaths
fiction_rankings <- tuesdata$fiction_rankings
```

```{r}
head(fiction_citations)
head(fiction_deaths)
head(fiction_rankings)
```
```{r}
ggplot(
  fiction_deaths,
  aes(
    x = confidence,
    fill = if_else(undone, "Reversed", "Not reversed")
  )
) +
  geom_bar() +
  geom_text(
    stat = "count",
    aes(label = after_stat(count)),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ franchise_slug, ncol = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Recorded deaths by franchise, evidence, and reversal",
    subtitle = "40 of 307 recorded deaths were later reversed (13.0%).",
    x = "Evidence type",
    y = "Number of recorded deaths",
    fill = "Death outcome",
    caption = paste0(
      "Shown = directly depicted; stated = reported by a character or narrator.\n",
      "Author: Jason You | Source: Cited Feats / TidyTuesday, 2026-11-10"
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )
```
```{r}


reversal_rates <- tapply(
  fiction_deaths$undone,
  fiction_deaths$confidence,
  mean
)

ggplot(
  fiction_deaths,
  aes(
    x = confidence,
    fill = if_else(undone, "Reversed", "Not reversed")
  )
) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  facet_wrap(~ franchise_slug, ncol = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(
    title = "Death reversal proportions within each franchise",
    subtitle = "Overall, 15.9% of the shown death were reversed, compared with 4.1% of stated deaths",
    x = "Evidence type",
    y = "Percentage of recorded deaths",
    fill = "Death outcome",
    caption = paste0(
      "Author: Jason You | Source: Cited Feats / TidyTuesday, 2026-11-10"
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )
```
